description.value: Caffè Mira is a neighbourhood coffee shop founded in 2017 with three locations across greater Vancouver, including this New Westminster spot at 28 E Royal Ave. The café serves coffee drinks, sandwiches, pastries, and other fresh dishes for dine-in or takeout. Catering is also available, making it a practical stop for both a quick refuel and a longer sit-down break.

address.value: 28 East Royal Avenue Unit 130, New Westminster
